title: Top Picks Recommendation Response Contract
description: Response contract for GET /recommendations/{user_id}, owned by Platform Infrastructure. The Top Picks row on the member home page validates every 200 body against the root schema and every 404 body against #/$defs/ErrorResponse. The client drops any response that does not validate. This document defines shape only.
$comment: Owner: Aisha Bello, Backend Engineer, Platform Infrastructure. Contract version 1.0, November 2026. Response fields: user_id, recommendations, title_id, title_name, primary_genre, score, latency_ms. Pydantic response and error models must use these field names, id patterns and the Genre enum exactly as written here.

user_id.description: Member the picks were built for. Same value as the {user_id} path parameter. Corresponds to member_id in netflix_viewing_events_2026-08-17_to_2026-11-16.csv (M-10001 to M-10600).

recommendations.description: Exactly 10 picks for the member, ordered by score from highest to lowest (index 0 is rank 1). title_id must be unique across all 10 items, so no title appears twice in one response. JSON Schema uniqueItems compares whole objects and cannot key on a single field. The service and its tests must enforce title_id uniqueness explicitly, and the client treats a duplicate title_id as a contract violation.

latency_ms.description: Optional. Server-side time in milliseconds to build this response, measured from request receipt to body serialization. Omit the field or send null when the value is not measured.

RecommendationItem.description: One recommended title in the Top Picks row.

title_id.description: Catalog title identifier. Must be a title_id present in netflix_title_catalog_2026-11.csv (TT-0001 to TT-0300).

title_name.description: Title name exactly as written in the title_name column of netflix_title_catalog_2026-11.csv for this title_id.

primary_genre.description: Primary genre of the title, from the primary_genre column of netflix_title_catalog_2026-11.csv.

score.description: Similarity score used to rank the item. A higher score ranks first. Across the recommendations array, scores are non-increasing from index 0 to index 9.

Genre.description: The 12 catalog genres used for primary_genre and secondary_genre in netflix_title_catalog_2026-11.csv. Values are case-sensitive and hyphenated as listed.

ErrorResponse.description: Body returned with HTTP 404 when no picks can be served for the requested user_id, for example when the member is unknown. The client shows no Top Picks row for this response.

detail.description: Human-readable reason the request could not be served.

user_id.description: The user_id exactly as requested in the path. No pattern is applied, so a malformed id can be echoed back unchanged.
